user_selected_target: Match GMP: median time on principal workloads no greater than GMP; no registered key shape above 1.2 times GMP

measurement_contract.ratio: VeriGMP elapsed time divided by GMP elapsed time for equal result semantics
measurement_contract.baseline: GMP public mpn_mul_n/mpn_sqr followed by the required low-half copy and precision mask; any alternative GMP public baseline must be recorded before tuning
measurement_contract.controls: Same machine, inputs, precision, compiler metadata and preallocated caller buffers; rotated or interleaved repetitions; raw samples retained
measurement_contract.confirmation: A second independent measurement run must confirm the target before backend promotion
measurement_contract.scope: A result applies to the measured platform and pinned builds; it is not universal GMP parity

solver_acceptance.policy: Freeze representative arithmetic traces and exact expected results from the GMP-backed paper algorithm before tuning the replacement. Report per-operation and whole-workload medians, memory use and all regressions; confirm semantic equivalence before switching.
solver_acceptance.backend_switch: The solver continues using trusted GMP until semantic and performance acceptance passes. A library-only pass does not establish solver parity.
